A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a reconfigurable, technology-aware, and energy-efficient architecture for deep SNN acceleration using Memristive Cross-bar Arrays.
RESPARC provides a scalable, reconfigurable, and energy-efficient architecture for deep SNN acceleration using memristive crossbars.
RESPARC is the first architecture to provide a complete system for deep SNN acceleration and to evaluate the energy efficiency of such systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

RESPARC can be used as a technology-aware architecture for SNNs, which is scalable to a wide range of crossbar technologies, and provides significant performance and energy benefits over the baseline digital architecture.
RESPARC can be a promising architecture for future neuromorphic computing systems.
